targets.material: Walnut kernels
targets.preparation: Walnut kernels; assay-specific extraction

evidence.statement: LC-HRMS identified ellagitannins in the tested walnut material.

targets.limitations: Qualitative presence only; batch and analytical extraction vary. No predictable urolithin A exposure or PM8 benefit inferred.

targets.material: Cavendish and plantain bananas
targets.preparation: Green/unripe; cultivar and ripening state matter

evidence.statement: Direct starch analyses examined resistant-starch decline during ripening in two cultivars.

targets.limitations: Qualitative source; no amount inferred from total carbohydrate or fibre and no fixed fermentation yield.

targets.material: Yukon Gold, Dark Red Norland and Russet Burbank potatoes
targets.preparation: Baked or boiled, then chilled to 4°C; distinguish reheated material

evidence.statement: Resistant starch was measured by cooking method and service temperature.

targets.limitations: Preparation-specific assay; no generic amount or fixed SCFA yield. Quantities have not been extracted into this ledger.

targets.material: Cooked black beans
targets.preparation: Cooked; cooking duration and cooling protocol remain study-specific

evidence.statement: The study directly assayed resistant starch in cooked black beans, pinto beans and chickpeas.

targets.limitations: Qualitative source only; assay included dry-weight quantities. Do not convert these to cooked-food fresh weight. Experimental room-temperature holding is not a food-handling recommendation.

targets.material: Cooked chickpeas
targets.preparation: Cooked; cooking duration and cooling protocol remain study-specific

evidence.statement: The study directly assayed resistant starch in cooked black beans, pinto beans and chickpeas.

targets.material: Analytical cell-wall pectin fractions from the thirteen apple cultivars studied by Liu et al.
targets.preparation: Cultivar-specific extracted analytical fractions; not a standardised pectin dose

evidence.statement: The primary composition study isolated and characterised pectin from apple materials.

targets.limitations: Qualitative supply only; retain cultivar, fraction and food-matrix variation. No per-100-g pectin amount inferred from total fibre; whole fruit is not purified citrus pectin.

targets.material: Chicken breast purchased in Turkey; cooking state not established
targets.preparation: Laboratory acid extraction at 121 °C; not a cooking recommendation or native-free-vitamer measurement

evidence.statement: Form-specific HPLC after the documented extraction supports the qualitative method-releasable niacin pool in this sample.

targets.limitations: No numerical amount, free-vitamer pool, cooking yield, bioavailability or food-to-NAD effect inferred. Total niacin is not relabelled as either form.

targets.material: Commercial POM Wonderful 100% pomegranate juice batches assayed in Singh et al.
targets.preparation: Chilled commercial juice; not whole-fruit or other-product equivalence

evidence.statement: The primary human study assayed ellagic acid and punicalagins in the administered juice matrix.

targets.limitations: Product and batch dependent. No urolithin A was detected in the juice; microbial conversion is variable. No whole-fruit quantity, ordinary-serving efficacy or brain benefit inferred.

targets.material: Authenticated Cichorium intybus market taproots; isolated inulin characterised
targets.preparation: Taproots dehydrated at 40°C, followed by laboratory extraction; qualitative source, not a household preparation protocol

evidence.statement: Primary isolation from chicory taproot identified beta-(2,1) fructan by FTIR and reported extracted inulin degree of polymerisation 26.

targets.limitations: Extraction/product characterisation, not a fresh-food serving assay or efficacy study. No root quantity, retention during cooking, or response equivalent to purified inulin inferred.

targets.material: Helianthus tuberosus tubers sampled at defined maturity and storage conditions
targets.preparation: Harvest maturity and storage-specific laboratory analysis; cooked products not tested

evidence.statement: Primary tuber profiling reported high-polymerisation inulin, including a DP-above-30 fraction; storage altered the chain-length distribution.

targets.limitations: Variety, maturity, storage and chain length limit generalisation. No cooked-food quantity, universal microbial response, butyrate yield or mucus benefit inferred.
